# The differences between the react-resizable-panels port on Div and the
# package itself in pinned Chromium, measured by tests/fidelity_panels.rs
# (Div 92ea25a0, Chrome for Testing 147.0.7727.50, react-resizable-panels
# 4.22.1). Each is listed, value for value, under the gap that owns it
# (docs/gaps.md). Change this list only with a Div bump, a port change or a
# recapture, and say why in the PR.
